what: The query plan behind data/weights-corpus.json. Kept in the repo so the corpus can be rebuilt and so anyone can see which parts of the catalogue were deliberately sampled and which were not.
how: Each query is sent verbatim to the production /api/search, which appends the ten-site filter itself. A query is a sampling decision, not a test: the titles it returns are labelled by hand afterwards.
